title: fix(i18n): approval step label and approval notification object label read as /meta serves them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DD8XEF1VwrqXiQzo8zQCjY)_
Fixes #35384
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — Metadata-protocol is none and there is no (narrowing) arm; no skills/** file teaches either label reading

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在「编写语言与默认语言不同」的部署里(例如英文编写、用户默认中文),英文读者在审批收件箱和审批页上看到的审批步骤名，以及英文收件人收到的审批通知里的对象名，改为作者原文，不再混入中文；对象在代码里改过名的，通知里显示新名。
- 为什么做：这是「审批与审计文案按元数据接口同一方式取标签」那张卡的最后两项，前两批已合并，本次合并后该卡关闭。
- 出错会怎样：只影响审批步骤名和通知里的对象名这两处显示文字，取不到时退回原先存下的文字，不会让审批或通知失败；改动可整体撤回，已存的通知照旧显示。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The rule this card carries (from #34030): "resolve the label through `translateObject` with the same resolve options `/meta` builds, so `t()` carries messages only". This PR delivers the card's two remaining items (items 2 and 3 landed in #36464 and #36598).

**1. Approval notification object label (service-messaging, plugin-approvals).**
- `NotificationTextKeys.params` accepts a new value, `{ object: 'OBJECT_API_NAME', fallback }` (`NotificationObjectLabelParam`, exported from `@objectstack/service-messaging`). `renderWith` resolves it through `translateObject` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) over the object's served definition (`getSchema`) and its packaged base (`registry.getPackagedObjectBase`), both read off the data engine the renderer already holds. The resolve options are `/meta`'s: the recipient's negotiated locale, the declared fallback chain, and the declared `sourceLocale` else `defaultLocale`, inlined as `reader-locale-labels.ts` does (one exported builder is #36467). `fallback` is delivered when nothing resolves.
- The inline fan-out, the dispatcher (claimed rows and digests) and the inbox reader (`renderForReader`) all go through `renderWith`, so all four paths resolve the label the same way.
- Widening, not replacement: `{ key, fallback }` is still accepted and still renders through `t()`, so stored outbox and inbox rows render exactly as before. The closed-shape validator (`problemOf`) admits the new shape and refuses a mixed one, a missing `fallback`, or a name that is not an object API name. The name shape is one segment of the existing catalog-key shape, so every object a `{ key: 'objects.OBJECT.label' }` param could name, the typed param can name too.
- plugin-approvals `subjectParams` now emits `{ object: objectName, fallback }`.

**2. Approval step label (spec, plugin-approvals).**
- New spec export `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel(bundle, flowName, nodeId, literal?, opts?)` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`. It is the one reading of `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE_ID.label`, using the same locale chain and the same bundle-then-literal order as `resolveFlowScreenTitle`.
- `reader-locale-labels.ts` `stepLabel` resolves through it with the `/meta` resolve options it already builds for the flow, object and position labels. No key is asked of `t()` any more.
- `translateFlow` is unchanged and stays unregistered in `translateMetadataDocument`.
- Liveness `flows.approvals.label` evidence is re-anchored on the spec resolver.

### Export choice (seat ruling, premise measured)

The seat ruled: overlay the step label inside `translateFlow` if the step-label read points already hold or read the flow document; otherwise use `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`. Measured at `aff34baea`:

- `reader-locale-labels.ts:405-410` (`localizeRequestLabels`) has only `process_name` and `current_step` from the stored row. No flow document is in hand. It is called for every row of a list read (`approval-service.ts:10921`, `listRequests`), for the single read (`:11205`), and by the generic data door (`reader-locale-labels-middleware.ts:104`). Getting a document there would add one flow read per row.
- `flowLabel` (`reader-locale-labels.ts:359`) does not read the flow document. It hands `translateFlow` a stub, `{ name: flowName }`. So do the other `translateFlow` callers in the tree: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:445` and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/stageChangeStarts.tsx:106` both pass `{ name, label }`.
- Only the single-read enrichment holds the document (`approval-service.ts:11340` `requestFlow`, used by `attachFlowSteps` `:11350` and `attachFlowRoute` `:11407`).

The premise does not hold at the main read point, so this PR takes `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`. `translateFlow` and its docblock are untouched, so no client-visible change.

The param's member is `object`, by seat ruling (card comment 7091274184), and the type name stays `NotificationObjectLabelParam`. Three reasons:
- The member holds the object's API name, not a label.
- In the spec, the word `object` always means an object's API name.
- The sibling `{ key, fallback }` is also named for what it holds.

The first round built it as `objectLabel` and round 2 renamed it. The mixed shape `{ object, fallback, key }` is still refused.

### Tests changed (forced)

- `plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.test.ts`: two pins that drove the step label through a `t()`-only double were re-triaged onto `getTranslations`. One is "negotiates through `resolveBundleLocale`…" and the other is "asks the service once per read, and never through t()". The `#35384` flow/position sourceLocale describe now also covers the step label.
- `plugin-approvals/src/no-approver-note.test.ts`: its local renderer narrows the widened `ApprovalTextParam` union. TS2339 came from `check:test-typecheck`, and no assertion changed.

## Tests

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- New pins: spec `i18n-resolver.test.ts` describe `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel` (5 cases: locale + `zh` ladder, declared chain, authored locale sourceLocale en / default zh-CN, literal and empty-bundle fallbacks, own keys). service-messaging `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts` describe `#35384` (7 cases on a real ObjectQL + SqlDriver: precondition, inline fan-out, SQL outbox + dispatcher, renamed packaged object with `/meta`'s `translateMetadataDocument` as oracle, inbox reader en / en-US / zh-CN, `t()`-only service, closed shape). plugin-approvals `approval-notification-keyed-text.integration.test.ts` describe `[#35384]` (real ApprovalService plus real MessagingService: an en approver reads `Deal`, a zh-CN approver reads `商机`, a renamed object reads its rename).
- Full suites on `2dfa8720` (the code head; the later merge of `origin/main` touched no file in these packages): `@objectstack/service-messaging` Test Files 80 passed (80), Tests 1084 passed (1084); `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` Test Files 127 passed (127), Tests 1883 passed (1883); `@objectstack/spec` (on `9d5362af`, spec unchanged after) Test Files 880 passed (880), Tests 28058 passed, 1 todo. Typecheck of all three packages, including spec's `check:test-typecheck` and approvals' `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0.
- Round 2, the rename of the member to `object`, at `cfce553f`: `pnpm exec turbo run build` of both closures (40/40 tasks), then the typecheck of service-messaging and plugin-approvals (including `check:test-typecheck`) exited 0. `@objectstack/service-messaging` Test Files 80 passed (80), Tests 1084 passed (1084). `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` Test Files 127 passed (127), Tests 1883 passed (1883). The closed-shape pin still refuses `{ object, fallback, key }`. Spec is unchanged in round 2.
- Ablation (round 1; one lock call each, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` plus a trap restore; every subject resolves from `src/`, so there is no dist leg; each leg's anchor went x1 to x0 and was restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Leg 1a, messaging object label read through `t()`: 5 failed / 7 of the `#35384` describe.
  - Leg 1b, no `packagedBase`: 1 failed / 7 (the rename case). The first attempt was refused by the tool as a no-op (the replacement text already existed elsewhere), so it was re-run with a distinct replacement.
  - Leg 2, approvals `stepLabel` back on `t()`: 5 failed / 37.
  - Leg 3, spec resolver walking the declared chain for the authored locale: 1 failed / 5.
  - Leg 4, approvals `subjectParams` back to `{ key }`: 2 failed / 8 (both end-to-end `[#35384]` cases).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Version skew: an older `service-messaging` refuses `{ object, fallback }` at `emit()`. Both packages are in the changeset `fixed` group, and the changeset says to upgrade them together.
- A `t()`-only i18n double (no `getTranslations`) now gets the `fallback` for the typed param, not the `t()` row. `II18nService.getTranslations` is a required member, so every served service hands its translations over.
- Other producers that name an object through `{ key: 'objects.OBJECT.label' }` keep the `t()` reading until they adopt the typed param. Only plugin-approvals emits it today (`git grep objectLabelKey` under packages/services and packages/plugins).

- CI on the round-1 head `0b91c34b`: Test UI, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check read red, and none of them is a test or type failure. Run 45109434849 concluded `cancelled` at 04:07:57Z because the push of `cfce553f` (committed 04:07:17Z; its CI run 45109928513 was created at 04:07:32Z) superseded it. Every Test UI, Test Core, Lint and Type Check lane on `0b91c34b` concluded `cancelled` between 04:07:33Z and 04:07:57Z. The three rollups only report that: Test UI logged "the Test UI shards concluded 'cancelled'", Lint & Repo Gates logged "lint lane ... concluded `cancelled`" for four lanes, and TypeScript Type Check logged "type-check lane ... concluded `cancelled`" for three lanes, with no `error TS` line. Nothing under `ui/**` or `examples/**` consumes `NotificationTextParam`, `ApprovalTextParam` or the stored `keyed_text` (`git grep`). The only in-repo narrowing site was `no-approver-note.test.ts`, fixed in round 1.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/services/service-messaging/src/notification-text.ts` (`renderWith` and the private `objectLabel` resolver; risk: the validator's new branch), `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (`resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`), `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.ts` (`stepLabel`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts -t 35384` should show 7 passed. The en recipient reads `Your Opportunity D_1 awaits approval.`, and the renamed object reads `Deal`.
